newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF tells Asahi Bank to tighten supervision.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF tells Asahi Bank to tighten supervision.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Friday that it had instructed Asahi Bank to tighten up its internal supervision of its overseas operations.
The move is a result of misconduct carried out at Asahi's New York branch, the MOF said.
Asahi and its New York branch were fined $5 million by the U.S. Federal Reserve on February 13 for the misconduct.
In November, Asahi president Shigehiko Yoshino told Japan's Kyodo news agency that bank employees had opened a sealed U.S. Federal Reserve inspection report regarding Asahi.
Asahi has said it incurred no losses in the case other than the fine and that it would maintain its U.S. operations.
